nyt.label: New York Times
nyt.description: Newsroom graphics: a headline that states the finding, values printed on the marks, series named at their own ends.
nyt.guidance:
- `title` is the finding, in a sentence; `subtitle` names the measure, the population and the unit.
- Colour can tell 5 categories apart; past that they share a grey.

economist.label: The Economist
economist.description: Print weekly: compact, flat headline over a deck that names the measure, units repeated down the ruler.
economist.guidance:
- `subtitle` names the measure, the place and the period — "% of GDP, 2023".
- Annotate each measure with `unit` in `semantic_types`.
- The key holds 3 colours.

de-stijl.label: De Stijl
de-stijl.description: De Stijl (Neo-Plasticism): red, yellow and blue planes bounded by heavy black lines on off-white, only horizontals and verticals, and the title set under the picture like a museum label.
de-stijl.guidance:
- The 5-colour key is the three primaries, then black and grey; more series than that fall to grey. A ramp is cut into flat steps.
- Lines and areas step rather than slope, so the shape of a series reads as a staircase.
- The title prints below the chart, in italic; keep it short, as a work title is.

bbc.label: BBC News
bbc.description: BBC News graphics (bbplot): Reith Sans, a large bold headline, light horizontal gridlines with no axis lines or titles, a heavy rule at zero, and a footer rule closing every chart.
bbc.guidance:
- `title` is the story in a few words; `subtitle` says what is measured and over what period, since the axes carry no titles.
- The 4-colour key is BBC blue, amber, dark red and green; more series than that read poorly.
- Name a source: it prints under the footer rule, with the BBC’s name at the other end.

material.label: Material
material.description: Material Design 3: the baseline purple-led tonal palette, Google Sans and Roboto type with a medium-weight title, light outline-variant gridlines, no axis lines, and bars rounded to the M3 shape scale.

interactionPresets.label: Click highlight

options.name: reset
options.note: Gestures that return this interaction to its neutral state.

options.note: Defaults to 'click'.

options.name: reset

options.note: Show compact series-colored labels on value guides inside the plot. Defaults to true.

options.name: guide
options.type: { visible?, style?: { color?, opacity?, width?, fillOpacity?, haloColor?, haloOpacity?, haloWidth? } } | false

options.name: reset
options.note: Releases a locked series. Defaults to ['escape'].

interactionPresets.label: Navigate
interactionPresets.description: Drag to pan, wheel or pinch to zoom, and a reset gesture to return to the full frame.

options.name: axes
options.note: 'available' navigates every axis the chart confirms. Defaults to 'available'.

options.name: pan
options.note: Defaults to true.

options.name: zoom
options.note: Defaults to true.

options.name: wheelSensitivity
options.note: Defaults to 0.002.

options.name: reset
options.note: Returns the viewport to the full frame. Defaults to ['double-click'].

options.name: resetTransition
options.note: The flight home on reset. Defaults to 400 ms; `{ duration: 0 }` jumps.

interactionPresets.label: Drag reorder
interactionPresets.description: Drag a mark or an axis label to reorder the categories.

options.name: reset
options.note: The order is a setting, so nothing resets it unless this list says so.

interactionPresets.label: Accessible navigation
interactionPresets.description: Tab into the chart and walk its titles, axes, legends, headers, series, and marks with the keyboard; each step announces what the element is and what it represents.

options.name: emphasis
options.note: Dim the marks outside the focused element, as a click highlight does. Defaults to true.

options.name: caption
options.note: Show a visible caption naming the focused element and its content. Defaults to true.

options.name: sections
options.note: The chart parts the walk reaches, in reading order. Defaults to every section.

options.name: maxFields
options.note: The most data fields read out for one mark. Defaults to 8.

interactionPresets.label: Filter controls
interactionPresets.description: Checkboxes, a range, or a switch beside the chart narrow the rows it shows, or highlight them.

options.name: fields
options.note: The fields that get a control. Listed fields always get one. When absent, the categorical, boolean, and temporal fields are chosen, up to four, skipping a field another interaction already filters: the color field under `legend-toggle`, a continuous axis field under `navigate` or `brush-zoom`.

options.name: mode
options.note: `filter` removes the rows that fail; `highlight` keeps them and mutes their marks. Defaults to `filter`.

options.name: placement
options.note: Defaults to `auto`.

options.name: render
options.note: False draws nothing; the host draws its own controls and drives the preset through `dispatch`. Defaults to true.

options.name: initial
options.note: Filters applied when the chart mounts.

options.name: dimOpacity
options.note: Opacity of the marks that fail in `highlight` mode.

interactionPresets.label: Context menu
interactionPresets.description: Pick marks with a rectangle, lasso, brush, click, right-click, or long press; a menu of host actions opens beside them, and picking one emits the action with the marks.

options.name: items
options.note: The actions the menu lists. Picking one emits a `menu-select` event whose `item` is the action's id and whose target is the selected marks.

options.name: gesture
options.note: How the reader picks the marks. Defaults to 'rectangle'. A rectangle or brush stays on screen to move or resize; a click or a long press picks one mark; a right-click opens the menu on a mark without highlighting it.

options.name: reset
options.note: Gestures that clear the selection and close the menu.

options.name: render
options.note: False draws nothing; the host draws its own menu from the selection events. Defaults to true.

interactionCapabilities.cartesian-region: a plot to drag a region on
interactionCapabilities.angular-region: a polar chart with an angular region
interactionCapabilities.reorder: a discrete axis whose order can change
interactionCapabilities.discrete-axis: a discrete axis with category labels
interactionCapabilities.index: an index axis shared by the series
